tool_args.rationale: The broad sink-gradient variation and concave response support the archived two-layer siphon. Numerically fitting and comparing its square-root and linear branches uses the acquired discriminating observation without another measurement.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Retained as a competing fitted branch; select it only if its training residual is lower.
These have more free parameters; the archived two-layer siphon directly matches the observed signatures and can be tested first.
The observations do not establish a need for a coupled temporal mechanism, and the existing six rows support fitting the static siphon branches.
